subject: collate: latin1_bin has the same collate with utf8mb4_bin,utf8_bin (#60702)
summary: Reviewed this commit (vs first parent) focusing on planner subquery rewrites and collation gating. The only substantive behavior change is `collate.CompatibleCollate` now treats `latin1_bin` as compatible with `utf8_bin`/`utf8mb4_bin` in both argument orders, which can enable `IN (subquery)`→join+distinct-agg rewrite (`pkg/planner/core/expression_rewriter.go`) and some planner path checks that rely on `CompatibleCollate`. Verified `latin1_bin`, `utf8_bin`, and `utf8mb4_bin` all use the same runtime collator (`binPaddingCollator` via `pkg/util/collate/collate.go` init; implementation in `pkg/util/collate/bin.go`), so treating them as compatible is consistent with executor comparison/key semantics; the `NO_DECORRELATE` logic change is a refactor into `isNoDecorrelate` with no semantic delta. Checked later history on `upstream/master`: `CompatibleCollate` remains unchanged (no follow-up revert/fix specific to this change).
